name: 飛水峡
query: "飛水峡" (渡船 OR 遊覧船 OR ロープウェイ OR シャトル OR 空港 OR GTFS) アクセス
finding: Prefectural gateway is JR Kami-Asou. The municipal interchange 上麻生駅 is named but has no exact licensed P11 identity; national named scan has no locality-qualified bus record. Shirakawa pocket-park guidance specifies road access, not Shirakawaguchi station. No official passenger ferry or aerial gateway to this gorge was established.
candidates: 木の国七宗コミュニティセンター
boundary: Municipality must publish reusable exact station-bus identity; tourism publisher must explicitly validate any additional gorge gateway. A railway signal box is not a tourist station; the Shirakawa viewpoint is not automatically the same entrance.

name: 御影大橋
query: "御影大橋" (船 OR ロープウェイ OR シャトル OR 空港 OR バス) 金沢
finding: Visual city walking course, prefectural Kanazawa station circuit and tourism Flat Bus map confirm two useful identities. Nearby Mikagecho/Tomimotocho stops are inventory candidates, but no exact bridge-access instruction establishes them. Kobe/Yokohama namesakes and Komatsu factory-event shuttle are different destinations.
boundary: Additional bus stop needs a published bridge approach/gateway assertion. Airport and port are regional destinations without a documented useful last-mile relationship; geometric proximity is insufficient.

name: 田倉山
query: "田倉山" (ケーブル OR ロープウェイ OR シャトル OR 空港 OR バス) 福知山
finding: Takurayama/Hozan is reached from Kami-Yakuno rail and its municipal bus interchange. The local bus network contains Noshonosato and Shirai, but neither is an official mountain-trail gateway in reviewed sources. Basalt park and Wadayama regional access do not bind this summit. No additional current ropeway/ferry/shuttle gateway was found.
boundary: City/tourism owner must identify additional actual trail access stops. Adjacent facilities or inactive Noshonosato buildings cannot establish mountain access; no evidence proving physical nonexistence of a third gateway.

name: 池原橋
query: "池原橋" (船 OR ロープウェイ OR シャトル OR 空港 OR 駅 OR バス)
finding: 2026 engineering field report documents village interpretation board and Ikehara-Ohashi stop at the actual bridge. Village network offers the R169 bus. The pre-1929 ferry is historical, not an active port. Ikehara/dam/sports-park stops and distant Yamato-Kamiichi rail are not individually asserted as this bridge's visitor gateways.
boundary: Bridge/village access publisher must validate another exact gateway or publish a bounded definitive access inventory. Regional bus connectivity alone does not authorize all route stops or a distant rail hub.

name: まほろば湖
query: "まほろば湖" (バス OR 遊覧船 OR ロープウェイ OR 空港 OR 送迎) 初瀬ダム
finding: Reservoir identity and Hasedera-station shore hike confirmed. Local stops Yokiura/Hasedera-sandoguchi and Hase visitor centre do not independently bind the lake shore. Dam-card access is to Kashihara government office, explicitly separate from the dam, and must not be imported as lake topology. An old city brochure URL returned 404; current owner/tourism and operator alternatives were examined.
boundary: Dam/city owner must identify additional shore/trail gateway stops; do not route to the water centroid or substitute the off-site card collection office. No definitive fewer-than-three assertion was published.

name: みさき公園
query: "みさき公園" (バス OR フェリー OR シャトル OR 空港 OR GTFS) site:town.misaki.osaka.jp
finding: Current town rules preserve public station-plaza/path access; former amusement rides remain excluded. Named station bus interchange lacks exact reusable stop identity in national P11 and reviewed GTFS. Fuke-Sumoto ferry serves another port; regional port promotion and the expired 2006 discount are not an exact current park gateway statement.
boundary: Town/operator needs reusable precise identity for the station bus stop; a railway centroid cannot become a bus boarding point. Additional coastal entrances need explicit park-gateway evidence; no new Canonical exclusion used.

name: 阿瀬川橋
query: "阿瀬川橋" (駅 OR バス OR 港 OR 船 OR ロープウェイ OR 空港 OR 観光)
finding: City inventory identifies bridge 1148 on Shinogaki/Kuriyama old road. Licensed P11 has Kuriyama and Mikata community-centre stops at 25m/18m; 2026 Mikata bus network confirms their service. Neither source says these stops are an actual visitor gateway for the bridge. Tourism map, demand-stop map and historical shrine record did not establish that relationship. Tokushima namesake rejected.
candidates: 城崎温泉ロープウェイ
boundary: The bridge/road/tourism authority must publish an exact visitor endpoint and a useful transport gateway relationship. All nearby records remain candidates; no proximity-only acceptance, Canonical deletion or inferred tourist restriction.

name: 韮崎中央公園陸上競技場
query: "韮崎中央公園" (シャトル OR 空港 OR ロープウェイ OR 港 OR GTFS)
finding: Venue/tourism explicitly name new gym bus and Fujimigaoka hall access; demand network points 118/120 corroborate names. Licensed Nirasaki GTFS available snapshot ends 2026-03-31 and lacks the new gym/hall stops; current feed lists no active file. P11 predates the 2025 service. Park mini-SL is a recreational ride, not an arrival transport gateway.
candidates: 東京エレクトロン韮崎アリーナ
boundary: Operator/city must publish licensed stop coordinates/identity for the gym/hall. Do not reuse arena/building centroid as stop coordinate; nearby older bus stops have no independent venue access assertion.

name: ミュージアム都留
query: "ミュージアム都留" (シャトル OR 空港 OR ロープウェイ OR 港 OR GTFS OR 停留所)
finding: Venue station and nearby city-station walk are confirmed. Official highway stop Chuo-do Tsuru and demand pickup 48 at museum are factual gateways but have no exact licensed node join. Wikidata Tsuru interchange is a highway junction, not a bus stop. Existing P11 Yamuramachi bus belongs to Fujikyu Bus; current demand operator is Fujikyu Yamanashi Hire, so same station name alone cannot establish the same boarding point.
candidates: 都留インターチェンジ
boundary: Municipality/operator must provide reusable highway-stop/demand-pickup point identities. No junction-to-stop alias, operator-blind join, or remote walk start used to meet quota.
